name: Pass & Screen Away
idea: After you pass, go set a screen for a teammate on the other side.
why: Defenders watch the ball. When you walk away from it to help a friend, nobody is ready for the screen, and your friend pops open.
tryit: After every pass, find a friend to screen for. Stand still like a wall with your feet wide and your arms in.

frames.say: {1} has the ball at the top. {2} and {3} are out on the wings.
*Screen away:* {1} walks away from the ball and stands still next to {X3}, like a wall.
{3} runs around the screen to the top. {X3} bumps into {1} and gets stuck!
{2} passes to {3}, who is wide open at the top.
Swish! Pass, then go screen for a friend. That’s Pass & Screen Away.
